packages.title: PyPI project names
packages.description: PyPI project names. Each line is either a name (requests), a name with a version (requests==2.31.0) or a project link (https://pypi.org/project/requests/). A name PyPI does not have comes back free with a reason.

maxPackages.title: Max packages
maxPackages.description: Read at most this many packages. The rest comes back as a free status row with the reason, never as a silent cut.

includeDependencies.title: Include dependencies
includeDependencies.description: Put the release dependencies (requires_dist, first 50) into the row. Off keeps rows small.
